ideas.name: NVIDIA Corporation
ideas.thesis: Appeared in all 6 overnight screens with unanimous high conviction. NVDA reports Q2 FY2027 earnings on August 26 (after close) with BofA projecting $94-95B revenue against $91B guidance — a $3-4B beat setup — and Q3 guidance seen at $107-108B vs. $104B consensus. The stock trades at ~16x forward earnings, a decade-low valuation, with a 34.5% gap to consensus analyst price target ($302.83) and 56% to BofA's $350 target from ~$224. All runs flagged a defined-risk call spread (e.g. long $230/$260 call spread, Sep 5 or Aug 29 expiry) as preferred over outright stock to manage binary sell-the-news risk if guidance merely meets expectations.
ideas.catalyst: Q2 FY2027 earnings report — August 26, 2026 after market close; Q3 guide vs. $104B consensus is the bull/bear line
ideas.edge: BofA projects $94-95B Q2 revenue vs. $91B guidance (~$3-4B beat); consensus PT $302.83 (+34.5% from ~$224); decade-low 16x forward P/E; EPS consensus ~$2.07 vs. $0.99 year-ago (+109% YoY)
ideas.bull_case: A beat-and-raise with Q3 guide at $107-108B triggers a multiple re-rating from decade-low 16x toward the $302-350 analyst target range, with VIX lows keeping call spread premiums historically cheap.
ideas.bear_case: Sell-the-news risk is real if Q3 guide merely meets the $104B consensus or export control headlines resurface — outright stock longs face binary downside; call spread structure caps this loss.
